commentary.text: 90' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90' CHANCE! Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) almost scores from distance, but smashes the ball against the crossbar!
87' 7 - 1 Goal! A rebound wrong foots everyone except Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao), and he slams the ball into the open net from close range. 7:1.
87' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
84' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Cesar Soto Grado had an easy-decision to make.
84' Valladolid are ruled offside.
82' A cross from the by-line finds Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) unmarked on the penalty spot, but he is unable to find the target and sends his header well wide of the left post.
79' Cesar Soto Grado shows a yellow card to Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) for his blatant foul.
78' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) launches a cross from the corner, but Karl Hein is alert to thwart the effort.
78' Excellent touch by Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao)! He latches on to a precise pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a terrific save.
78' The corner is swung in but Valladolid can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

77' Raul Moro (Valladolid) collects a simple pass and decides to shoot from distance. It's a swerving effort aimed towards the roof of the net, but Unai Simon reads it well and makes a comfortable save. The ball is out of play and Valladolid manage to earn a corner.
75' Here is a change. Oscar de Marcos is going off and Ernesto Valverde gives the last tactical orders to Inigo Lekue (Ath Bilbao).
75' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
69' 6 - 1 Goal - 6:1! Inaki Williams laid the ball off to Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao), who slots it into the back of the net from close range, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
68' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) will be replaced by Alex Berenguer.
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) departs the field of play to be replaced by Peio Canales.
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Tamas Nikitscher replaces Marcos Andre (Valladolid).
66' 5 - 1 Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Karl Hein with a strike into the top right corner. He makes it 5:1.
66' Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao) receives a pass then lets rip from long range towards the left of the goal, but Karl Hein watches it all the way and makes an easy save.

66' Well-positioned Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) was first to the rebound and fired in a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Karl Hein reacted superbly to keep the ball out. The fans could not believe their eyes. It was a miraculous stop!
66' This shall not pass! Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
65' Alvaro Rubio is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Joseph Aidoo (Valladolid) suffers an injury and Eray Comert comes on.
64' The substitution is prepared. Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta joins the action as a substitute, replacing Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao).
64' Ernesto Valverde has decided to substitute Maroan Sannadi (Ath Bilbao) and he is replaced by Gorka Guruzeta.
63' Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao) picks up a pass and unleashes a strong shot from inside the box, but the goalkeeper is equal to it!
61' Alvaro Rubio decides to make a substitution. Mario Martin will be replaced by Florian Grillitsch (Valladolid).
60' A pass from Raul Moro (Valladolid) is intercepted by Unai Simon and the move breaks down.
57' The attendance is 47715.
56' RED CARD! Stanko Juric (Valladolid) makes a bad challenge and receives a second yellow card from Cesar Soto Grado. He can have an early bath.
51' Valladolid quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

51' Darwin Machis (Valladolid) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the right-hand post, but Unai Simon was alert and the score remains the same. Valladolid have a corner.
50' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) latches onto a lofted pass on the edge of the penalty box and unleashes a volley towards goal, but it goes high over the crossbar.

47' 4 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Raul Moro slips the ball through to Mamadou Sylla (Valladolid), and he darts into the box to unleash a magnificent shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 4:1.
46' The game is interrupted. Stanko Juric (Valladolid) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
46' Half-time substitution. Alvaro Rubio decided to make a change. Antonio Candela (Valladolid) is replaced by Darwin Machis.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Chuki (Valladolid) is replaced by Raul Moro.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' 4 - 0 Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) scores a fabulous goal after latching onto a cross and smashing the ball inside the right post with a first-time volley!
45+2' Ath Bilbao have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
44' Mario Martin (Valladolid) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.

43' 3 - 0 It's a goal! Yuri Berchiche plays a lovely pass into the box and finds Maroan Sannadi (Ath Bilbao). He tries his luck from close range and coolly strikes the ball into the back of the net. 3:0.
43' A cross by Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.

37' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) superbly controls a difficult pass on the edge of the box and effortlessly let's fly with a magnificent low strike towards the middle of the goal, which the keeper somehow pushes away.
35' 2 - 0 Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Karl Hein with a low strike into the middle of the goal. He makes it 2:0.
35' The goal by Valladolid is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
35' Wait! Referee Cesar Soto Grado has indicated he is going to review the Valladolid goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
34' Mamadou Sylla (Valladolid) finds some space just outside the penalty area after getting on the end of a sweet pass and blasts the ball into the goal!
33' Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Karl Hein intercepts the ball.
29' Valladolid fail to score from a corner as Unai Simon (Ath Bilbao) leaps to collect the ball.
28' Valladolid take the free kick with a short pass.
28' Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Cesar Soto Grado has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
26' The corner from Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) is cleared away by the defence.
23' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) is able to continue to play.
22' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) is being forced to leave the pitch in order to receive medical treatment and his team will play with a man short for a few minutes.
22' PENALTY APPEAL after Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
21' Maroan Sannadi (Ath Bilbao) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header low towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop the effort.

20' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards the right side of the goal, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper with a stunning save.
19' Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
19' Karl Hein stretches to his right side and makes a brilliant save! Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) met a rebound outside the box and attempted to beat the keeper into the top right corner.
18' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
16' Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle and it's Maroan Sannadi (Ath Bilbao) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
14' Maroan Sannadi (Ath Bilbao) is adjudged offside.
14' Mamadou Sylla (Valladolid) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
14' It seemed like Mario Martin (Valladolid) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
13' Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) commits a rough challenge and Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle for an infringement. Valladolid have a free kick from a promising distance.
12' The resulting corner from Chuki (Valladolid) is cleared by the defence.

10' 1 - 0 Nico Williams looks around to decide who he is going to pass to. He picks out Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao), who collects the ball and unleashes a terrific shot from just outside of the box towards the bottom right corner and it ricochets in off the post. The score is 1:0.
8' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) shows off his skills with a mazy run to the edge of the box and then fires in a disappointing shot that flies high over the bar.
7' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
6' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) is first to react to a great cross from Inaki Williams, but slices his shot high over the bar from inside the box.
4' Stanko Juric (Valladolid) brings an opponent down and Cesar Soto Grado interrupts the game.
3' Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) receives the ball and has a go from distance, but he shouldn't have bothered as it sails high over the bar.
1' The first half has just begun.
Ath Bilbao will kick-off.
Cesar Soto Grado will supervise the game today.
